annotation.bound_parties_text: Self-certifying entities testing autonomous motor vehicles on public roadways must provide information, report collisions and violations, and give notice to law enforcement; the department must provide public access and an annual report.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: The self-certifying entity testing the autonomous motor vehicle on any public roadway must notify the department of:
annotation.dates_quote: "Section 1 of this act takes effect October 1, 2022."
